CustomObject.description: One record per question of a Form Template, holding that question's results worked out from its Form Submission Answers: how many answered, how many left it unanswered, the average score, and where they apply a Favorable share and a Net Promoter Score. Written by the Recalculate Results job; never edited by hand. Master-detail to Form Template, so the results are deleted with the template and share its access.
CustomObject.label: Form Template Result
